title: Total comparison for an integer bicomplex with finitely many columns
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K,L integer-indexed double cochain complexes [def-sp-double-complex-total] with total complexes, φ:K→L, and x₀,x₁ integers. Assume K and L have zero columns outside [x₀,x₁], and φ.f i is a quasi-isomorphism for each x₀≤i≤x₁. Then Tot(φ) is a quasi-isomorphism, including when x₁<x₀.

proof.text: Induct downwards on the finite number of retained columns using rowFiltrationGE. Above x₁ the truncations and totals are zero. On adjoining one column, shortComplexStupidFiltrationGE is degreewise split, as is its totalization. Its quotient total is the shifted column via singleColumnObjTotal, so the column hypothesis gives a quasi-isomorphism there. HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.quasiIso_τ₂ and the induction hypothesis give a quasi-isomorphism on the larger truncation. At or below x₀, the truncation inclusions are isomorphisms by strict support; transport along their total isomorphisms. This is the existing complete proof in the recorded source declaration, not an added hole.
